scope: External Game 1 provider-known-live, originally observed ball windows; forty deterministic nonoverlapping windows per duration.
decision: Do not extend linear interpolation to multi-second gaps. Geometry-only extrapolation has low coverage; full-gap linear filling is inaccurate even on smooth external tracking. Independently validate a frozen ball detector/observation source and uncertainty-aware paths before changing possession inference.
limitations: Externally masked ball coordinates are scored against originally observed Metrica tracking, not human-annotated physical ball positions.
Provider-known-live status selects external windows only, never enters inference.
Full-gap linear interpolation is an offline what-if, not an accepted model, challenge result or submitted output.
The public Metrica sample has much better live-ball coverage than automatic challenge tracking; distribution shift may be larger than these estimates.
No challenge video, output-video comparison or protected possession labels were used.
